correctness.rationale: The first-occurrence suffix recursion is exact by greedy earliest embedding. The base W2 and deleted-first-symbol suffix were verified directly, and a six-suffix induction proves the exact SAS sets for W_r=101(000101)^(r-1). Every admissible gap word contains W_r as a subsequence, while boundary gap counts force all nine candidate words to be absent. The ternary encoding of Cantor ones gives zero gaps 3^{nu_2(j)}, verifying hypotheses for all k>=2. Independent suffix-DP, literal embedding and exhaustive smaller-level checks passed. Finite tests are not substituted for the induction.

value.rationale: Gives an exact nine-word anti-subsequence classification at every Cantor substitution level, plus an invariant complete spectrum for a genuinely broader family with arbitrary internal zero-gap inflation. This strengthens mere universality-index counts, isolates exact information-loss patterns, and provides a useful structural benchmark for scattered-subword reconstruction and Simon spectra. It is not a small finite enumeration.
